player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ti. Guess The Number taphatteerra jira.
Ati lakkoofsi {min_number} fi {max_number} keessa jette, {max_turns} turnii keessa.
Jaldeebi kuni, tapha game kanaan ibsa 'higher' ykn 'lower' geessuun isaa.
Ati ibsa kuni yommuu taasisu, sirna tokko malee, lakkoofsi [5] kessa ayylonfamee tapha keessaa waan ta'eef.
Jette, jaldeebi kuni, tapha jaldeebsi keessan bittaa xumuramuu dha.
Meejarraa kana fudhachuun ala, ibsa keessan gahuu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Galaana qajeelfamaa micii irraa. Player {player_id} hin jaldeen yaada '[number]' ol ta'e.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Taphachiisaa {player_id} lakkoofsa daangaa murtaa'e keessaa ala ta'u tilmaame.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Invalid move. Player {player_id} has already guessed the number.

game_message.target_higher: Lakkoofsi namoota miidhamanis baay'ee ol ta'a.

outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
